about: GameTest times for tools/shard_plan.py, from green PR build runs ['42155545605', '42155377426', '42143067009', '42141839538', '42137601263'] (hosted runners). tests = median [TestTime] s; batches = median wall s of each named batch run whole; model: setup_s job start to first batch + last pass to job end, bar_extra_s the bar job's extra (jar build, JUnit), part_s + place_s x tests + slowest test = one batch part's wall. heavy_s (a policy, not measured): default tests at or over it are spread over the shards, ceil(chunk's heavy / shards) per batch part - the production tests generate far chunks and slow each other (264 s for 4 sharing, Oct 21); 90 s covers them, the raid parties, the siege razes and the bot skirmishes at +9% runner time over no spreading.
